title: A/R Summary: exporting an empty report downloads nothing and warns
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop works at two locations, and you untick every location on A/R Summary and then try to export it.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the Location filter.
  2. Click "Clear selection".
  3. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Location menu opens.
  • Step 2: no location is ticked; the native empty state shows with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column.
  • Step 3: the warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" shows and nothing is downloaded (no new file in the browser's downloads).
  • Step 4: the same warning shows and nothing is downloaded.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV), story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S3-R10: “A successful export shows the native "Success" message, "Data exported successfully." An export with no rows downloads nothing and shows the native warning "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results".”
  • S5-R6a: “With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export with no rows | "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results" | Warning toast; nothing downloads”
